cohort: 180 singleton pregnancies at > 34 weeks gestation without structural and chromosomal abnormalities, maternal diabetes, TORCH, or Rh factor isoimmunization
finding: Idiopathic polyhydramnios was associated with a higher rate of postpartum hemorrhage, cesarean delivery, and respiratory distress compared to normal pregnancy.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly higher in the idiopathic polyhydramnios group compared to normal pregnancy.
